info.title: DomainDash API
info.description:
REST API for DomainDash: domains, DNS, clients, hosting, SSL, internet services, HaloPSA tickets, domain pricing, portal users and audit logs.

**Authentication.** Every request must carry an API key in the `x-api-key` header (raw key value, NOT `Authorization: Bearer`). Keys are created by an administrator on the API Keys page. Each key has optional scopes (`<resource>.read` / `<resource>.write`; a key with no scopes may call everything), an optional IP allow-list and an hourly rate limit.

**Send `Accept: application/json`.** Without it Laravel may answer validation errors with an HTML redirect instead of a 422 JSON body.

**Base URL.** All paths below are relative to `{baseUrl}/api`.

**Pagination.** List endpoints use Laravel pagination: `?page=` and `?per_page=` (default 100); results are in `data` with `current_page`, `last_page`, `total`, `next_page_url`, etc. Ticket listing uses its own simpler envelope.

**Scopes required per operation** are listed in the `x-required-scope` extension on each operation.

baseUrl.description: Root URL of your DomainDash installation, without a trailing slash and without /api.

tags.name: DNS
tags.description: DNS zone records and nameserver settings.

get.description: Paginated list ordered by name. Only id, name, expiry_date and client_id are returned; use getDomain for the full record.

patch.summary: Assign a domain to a client
patch.description: Sets (or clears, with null/omitted) the owning client of the domain.

get.summary: Get a domain's EPP auth code
get.description: Fetches the transfer/EPP auth code live from the registrar. Sensitive.

post.description: Runs a synchronous full import of all domains from the registrar. Responds 202 with the number of domains imported once finished. Can be slow.

200.description: Availability result (ok=false if the registrar call failed).

post.description: Submits a transfer request to the registrar. Returns 200 with ok=false (not an HTTP error) if the registrar rejects it.
Returns 200 with ok=false (not an HTTP error) if the registrar rejects the renewal.

get.summary: List DNS records for a domain
get.description: Live read of the DNS zone from the registrar (not paginated).

put.description: Changes the registrar DNS mode and, for mode 1, the delegated nameservers.
Implemented as delete-then-add at the registrar (not atomic); the record gets a new record_id.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring match on business_name, abn, halopsa_reference or itglue_org_id.

put.description: Partial update; only supplied fields are changed.

get.description: Routed to the same handler as listDomains. NOTE: the {client} path value is currently NOT applied as a filter; pass `client_id` as a query parameter to filter by client.

200.description: Hosting service with client and domain relations.

post.summary: Sync hosting services from Synergy Wholesale
post.description: Synchronous full import; responds 202 when finished.

200.description: Certificate with client and domain relations.

post.summary: Sync SSL certificates from Synergy Wholesale
Refresh internet services from Vocus WSM
post.description: Refreshes existing services that have a vocus_service_id; individual failures are skipped silently. Responds 202 when finished.

get.description: Without client_id, tickets are fetched per client with a HaloPSA reference (page 1 only, per_page each), so `page` only applies when client_id is given. If client_id is unknown or has no HaloPSA reference the response is 200 with an empty data array and a message.

post.description: The client must have a halopsa_reference, otherwise 422.

get.summary: Get a ticket with its actions

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Substring match on name or email.

put.description: Partial update. Password cannot be changed through the API.

ApiKeyAuth.name: x-api-key
ApiKeyAuth.description: DomainDash API key. Required scopes: domains.read; domains.write; dns.read; dns.write; clients.read; clients.write; hosting.read; hosting.write; ssl.read; ssl.write; internet.read; internet.write; tickets.read; tickets.write; pricing.read; users.read; users.write; audit.read. Keys with no scopes are unrestricted.

PerPage.name: per_page
PerPage.description: Items per page (default 100). No server-side maximum is enforced on most list endpoints.

ClientIdQuery.name: client_id
ClientIdQuery.description: Only return records belonging to this client id.

DomainId.name: domain
DomainId.description: DomainDash domain id (numeric primary key, not the domain name).

RecordId.name: recordId
RecordId.description: Registrar DNS record id (`record_id` from the DNS list).

Tld.name: tld
Tld.description: TLD exactly as stored, e.g. `com.au`. May contain dots.

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid API key (`API key required` / `Invalid API key`).

Forbidden.description: Caller IP not in the key's allow-list (`IP not allowed`) or the key lacks the required scope (`Scope denied`).

NotFound.description: Resource not found (route-model binding miss). Body is Laravel's standard JSON 404 when `Accept: application/json` is sent.

RateLimited.description: Per-key hourly rate limit exceeded (`Rate limit exceeded`). Counted per key and client IP per clock hour.

BadGateway.description: Upstream provider (Synergy Wholesale / HaloPSA / Vocus) returned an error.

ServiceUnavailable.description: HaloPSA is not configured on this DomainDash instance.

ValidationError.description: Laravel validation error. Only returned as JSON when the request sends Accept: application/json.

PaginationEnvelope.description: Standard Laravel length-aware paginator fields (the items are in `data`).

dns_config.description: DNS mode (1 = custom nameservers; see updateDomainDnsOptions).

host.description: Host name; empty/omitted for the zone apex.

dns_mode.description: Registrar DNS mode. 1 = custom nameservers (nameservers are stored).

client_id.description: Existing client id, or null to unassign. Omitting the field also unassigns.

authInfo.description: EPP/auth code from the losing registrar.

address.description: Address lines (validated only as an array).

service_type.description: FTTC / FTTP / FTTB / FTTN / HFC / FIXED-WIRELESS

Ticket.description: Ticket object as returned by HaloPSA (pass-through; fields depend on the HaloPSA instance). Typically includes id, summary, details, tickettype_name, service_category and status.

total.description: Number of tickets in this response (not a global count).

message.description: Only present when client_id is given but unusable.

client_id.description: DomainDash client id; the client must have a halopsa_reference.

domain_id.description: Validated (must exist) but currently not used when creating the ticket.

service_id.description: Hosting service id. Validated but currently not used.

ssl_id.description: SSL certificate id. Validated but currently not used.

action_description.description: Reply text (added as a public/non-hidden action).

DomainPricing.description: Decimal columns may serialise as strings or numbers depending on the database driver.

role.description: Replaces the user's roles with this role; empty/null removes all roles.

x-scopes.domains.read: View domains, expiry dates and EPP auth codes
x-scopes.domains.write: Sync from Synergy, renew, transfer and assign domains to clients
x-scopes.dns.read: View DNS zone records for a domain
x-scopes.dns.write: Add, update and delete DNS records; change nameservers / DNS mode
x-scopes.clients.read: View client organisations and their domain list
x-scopes.clients.write: Create, update and delete client organisations
x-scopes.hosting.read: View hosting services and their usage statistics
x-scopes.hosting.write: Trigger hosting service sync from Synergy Wholesale
x-scopes.ssl.read: View SSL certificates and their status
x-scopes.ssl.write: Trigger SSL certificate sync from Synergy Wholesale
x-scopes.internet.write: Trigger internet service sync from Vocus WSM
x-scopes.tickets.read: View HaloPSA support tickets and their replies
x-scopes.tickets.write: Create tickets and post replies; close tickets
x-scopes.users.write: Create, update and delete portal users
